name: Algebraic System Translation
description: Translates a 1D geometric interval packing problem into a pure system of linear inequalities and disjunctions. This strips all spatial semantic clues (like "span", "overlap", or "length"), forcing the model to algebraically prove that the feasibility of these isolated inequality subsystems is exactly equivalent to the additive bounds p1+p2 <= T and sum(p1) <= T. Models relying on keyword-triggered heuristics for scheduling or geometry will fail to recognize the simple sum property and likely attempt to implement an SMT solver or graph algorithm, resulting in TLE or incorrect logic.
